agentKeys.copyManually: Please select and copy the {{label}} by hand.
agentKeys.intro: With an agent key, an AI agent of your choice (Claude Code, Cursor …) works in {{product}} on your behalf: planner, mail, calendar, contacts, documents. It only sees what you see. Sending, deleting and passwords always stay off limits.
agentKeys.loadError: Agent access could not be loaded.
agentKeys.disabled: Agent access is turned off in this installation. Whoever runs the server can turn it on
agentKeys.namePlaceholder: Name, e.g. Claude on the laptop
agentKeys.canWrite: May also make changes (create tasks, add events, write mail drafts)
agentKeys.noKeys: No key yet. Without a key, no agent gets in.

federation.title: Connected instances
federation.intro: Federated {{product}} instances — shared identity (OIDC), chat (Matrix) and files (Nextcloud).
federation.pairText: Generate a pairing code and give it to the admin of the other instance.

mobilePush.copyManually: Please select and copy the {{label}} by hand.
mobilePush.title: Notifications on your phone
mobilePush.tagline: So that invitations (e.g. to game rounds) and notices arrive even when {{product}} is not open — as real push messages via the ntfy app.
mobilePush.loadError: Could not load your push access ({{error}}).
mobilePush.qrHint: App password as QR code — to scan & paste
mobilePush.tokenNote: Keep it personal & secret. Managed automatically — no extra {{product}} password needed, nothing to remember.
mobilePush.step1: Install the ntfy app from the Play Store.
mobilePush.step2: In the app: ⋮ → Manage users → Add user → server {{server}}, username {{user}}, and paste the app password above as the password.

claraMemory.title: What {{assistant}} knows about me
claraMemory.intro: {{assistant}} remembers here — only with your consent in conversation — who you are and what matters to you, so she can help you better. You can change or delete anything; {{assistant}} uses the new state right away.
claraMemory.empty: {{assistant}} doesn't know you yet. Just say hello to her in the chat — she'll introduce herself and ask what you'd like her to remember.
claraMemory.confirmDeleteAll: Really delete everything {{assistant}} knows about you?
claraMemory.nudges: {{assistant}} may make suggestions (tours, getting-started tips). When off, she only speaks up when you address her.
claraMemory.changedByClara: Last changed by {{assistant}} (with your consent) on {{time}}

permissions.intro: When {{assistant}} asks before a critical action (power, deleting, messaging third parties, money), you can answer “Always” on the card. Every rule created that way is listed here. Without a rule {{assistant}} asks every time; without an answer she does nothing.
permissions.empty: No permanent permissions. {{assistant}} asks every time before critical actions.
permissions.footer: Applies to your account only. The push to your phone remains the second route when no rule applies.

appConnections.fillOne: {{app}}: please fill in at least one field
appConnections.title: App connections
appConnections.intro: Store your personal API token per app. {{assistant}} then uses your token for searches in that app — you only see your own data. Without a connection {{assistant}} uses the shared service token.
